selection: 2024 H2 after calibration labels; reused selection period, not independent
features: Clean cid age; add strictly prior, ID-linked win/top2/recent-win rates, year starts, sample strength and field-relative win rate
alpha_objective: H1 winner categorical log loss; ties prefer smaller alpha
selection_rule: Do not decrease any of the three H2 exact-hit counts versus repaired incumbent; maximize product of target-normalized hit rates, then lower joint log loss, then name; incumbent fallback
evaluation_role: Already inspected retrospective; previous interrupted candidate results also inspected, never unseen
distribution: Convex mixture of complete distinct ordered-triple distributions; weight one also tests specialist alone
forbidden: No odds, payouts, EV, target-race outcomes, inferred IDs or invented observation times
promotion: No automatic activation; save selected weights and full predictions; report tradeoffs and unmet goals
